title: Linear variance of the random 3-SAT unsatisfiability time
exact_target: Let $H_n$ be the first clause count at which sequential independent uniformly signed proper 3-clauses make an n-variable formula unsatisfiable. Are there absolute $c,C>0$ such that $cn\leq Var(H_n)\leq Cn$ for all sufficiently large n?
